evidenceAudit.scope: Woman with a twin pregnancy: chorionicity, appointment and scan schedule, discordance and twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) surveillance, anaemia, and preterm birth prevention with vaginal progesterone, using NICE NG137.
findings: Every dose, threshold and timing was checked against the cited source section on 2026-10-18.
Normal values are typical adult reference ranges; laboratories differ.
unverifiedSections: NICE NG137 as extracted does not mention aspirin and gives no drug dose beyond vaginal progesterone.
Progesterone for this indication was off-label as of April 2024.
No Saudi maternal-fetal medicine guideline was opened.
Source pages were read through automated page extraction rather than page-by-page in the original documents, so each figure should be spot-checked against the source during clinical review.
The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) drug registration site could not be opened from this environment, so registration of each medicine was not verified; check hospital formulary.

pathophysiology.summary: Chorionicity and amnionicity are determined at first detection; if unclear, manage as monochorionic. Dichorionic diamniotic twins need at least 8 appointments, monochorionic diamniotic twins at least 11, with at least 2 with the specialist obstetrician. Monochorionic pregnancies have ultrasound every 14 days from 16 weeks to detect TTTS; discordance of 20% or more or estimated fetal weight below the 10th centile increases monitoring to at least weekly with umbilical artery Doppler. Vaginal progesterone 200 mg at bedtime is offered if cervical length at 16 to 20 weeks is 25 mm or less.

redFlags: Deepest vertical pocket under 2 cm in one sac and over 8 cm (before 20+0 weeks) or over 10 cm (from 20+0 weeks) in the other: urgent tertiary referral.
Discordance of 25% or more with a baby below the 10th centile: refer to a tertiary fetal medicine centre.

clinicalManagement.title: Determine chorionicity
actions: Use placental masses, membranes, lambda or T-sign; manage as monochorionic if unclear.

clinicalManagement.title: Set the schedule
actions: Dichorionic: 8 appointments with scans at 11+2 to 14+1, 20, 24, 28, 32 and 36 weeks; monochorionic: 11 appointments with scans every 2 weeks from 16 weeks.

clinicalManagement.title: Cervical length
actions: Single scan; if 25 mm or less offer vaginal progesterone 200 mg at bedtime until 34 weeks or birth.

clinicalManagement.title: Monitor growth and TTTS
actions: Monochorionic: every 14 days from 16 weeks; dichorionic: every 28 days from 24 weeks; increase if discordance, low weight or pocket differences.

clinicalManagement.title: Refer to tertiary fetal medicine
actions: Discordance 25% or more with a baby below the 10th centile; severe pocket disparity.

regimens.indication: Prevention of preterm birth in twin pregnancy with cervical length 25 mm or less at 16 to 20 weeks
adjustments: No renal or hepatic adjustment is given in the source opened; check product information.
monitoring: Cervical length scan outcome and pregnancy progress.
contraindications: Off-label use as of April 2024; check product information for contraindications.

medicationPlan.note: Only vaginal progesterone has a dose in NICE NG137 as extracted. Aspirin is not mentioned. The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) drug registration site could not be opened from this environment, so registration of each medicine was not verified; check hospital formulary.

diagnosticCriteria.threshold: 11+2 to 14+1 weeks, then 20, 24, 28, 32 and 36 weeks; extra appointments at 16 and 34 weeks.
11+2 to 14+1 weeks, then every 2 weeks from 16 to 34 weeks.
Discordance 20% or more, or any baby estimated weight below the 10th centile, or deepest vertical pocket difference 4 cm or more.
25 mm or less on a single scan at 16 to 20 weeks.
